title: One surface, one URL, one panel at a time
context: The whole treasurer view is a single page. Panels open over the surface for detail. Anil's rule: no page loads after the first, no back button, one panel open at a time.
decision: The treasurer view lives at `/` and is a single React component (Surface in page.tsx). Panel state is a single value, not a stack — opening one closes the other by construction.
alternatives_rejected: Multi-page nav for the treasurer view (breaks the 'one URL to open on the day' rule)
Panel stack with a back button (invites drilling that has no return path in the mental model)
consequences: PanelShell owns scrim, escape, focus return
State refresh pattern: after every write, refetch full StateResponse — no optimistic updates
Persona expansion (admin/compliance/approvals) will use separate routes but each route keeps its own 'one surface, one panel' rule (ADR-0009)
